conclusion: The archived legacy-bound tests and current receiver-bound fixtures have identical pass/fail totals and identical failed test IDs in all three suites. No additional failure was observed after binding the fixtures to the receiver. The 19 skill/checkpoint failures were newly surfaced by this comparison but all are confirmed on the untouched HEAD test/source archive with the preserved dirty as1_skill.py overlay; the six jobs failures already match the recorded baseline. Because the receiver run uses active candidate producer files while the archive uses HEAD versions, this is a counterfactual status comparison rather than a fully controlled source-only causality test.
